verdict.rationale: All core document operations available in the product (parse, extract, split, classify, edit, and chained workflows) are documented as API endpoints with SDK examples. A public OpenAPI spec is published, and Studio-built pipelines deploy as Pipeline IDs callable from code, so work done in the UI carries over to the API. The same capabilities are also exposed through the CLI and MCP server. missing for 10: no explicit UI/API parity statement, no evidence that account and admin functions (API keys, billing, team settings) are API-accessible, webhook setup is documented only through the Studio sidebar, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
